title: THE CONTRACT LIST READS FROM THE COUCH
why: Seen on the Mainframe screenshot of 2026-10-07: each contract was a 15 pixel line with 13.5, 11 and 10.5 pixel lines under it (progress, what it pays, its tier) across a panel most of the screen wide, hard to read on a TV. Each is a few sizes up now; nothing else changes.
now: Contracts on the Mainframe are easier to read.

edits.replacement: .crow{ padding:13px 16px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(42,50,61,.35); font-size:18px; }   /* v16.xx, seen on the Mainframe screenshot (2026-10-07): the contract list read in 15, 13.5, 11 and 10.5 pixel lines across a wide panel; each a few sizes up */

edits.anchor: .crow .cp{ color:var(--ash); font-size:13.5px; margin-top:4px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }
edits.replacement: .crow .cp{ color:var(--ash); font-size:15.5px; margin-top:5px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; }
